preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)
Attacker must hold some tokens to trigger fee collection

exploit_hint: As owner, call setAllFeePercent() to set walletFee to maximum (10%). Then perform a token transfer to trigger fee collection. The wallet fee will be sent to feeWallet (which owner can control via setFeeWallet()). Alternatively, set feeWallet to attacker's address first, then set high fees and trigger transfers.
